name: 星空黑金
description: 深空冷峻神秘：深空紫黑 #0B0118 + 金色 #E6B800 细字 + 冷紫点缀。H1 金色字距 8px 居中+金细线、H2 金边框+内嵌小字、blockquote 左金线+深紫底、hr 金渐变。神秘冷峻派（vs night-read 温暖书房派，vs cyber-neon 霓虹派）。适合哲学/玄幻/科幻/冥想/神秘主义。

styles.h1: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 400; color: #E6B800; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 42px; margin-bottom: 32px; border-top: 1px solid #E6B800; border-bottom: 1px solid #E6B800; letter-spacing: 8px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h2: font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; font-style: italic; color: #E6B800; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(230,184,0,0.5); display: inline-block; letter-spacing: 3px;
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; font-style: italic; color: #E8E0FF; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.h4: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #E6B800; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h5: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #C9B8FF; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55; font-style: italic;
styles.h6: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #8A7BB0; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 15px; color: #E8E0FF; line-height: 2; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: background: rgba(230,184,0,0.06); border-left: 1px solid #E6B800; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 26px; font-size: 15px; color: #C9B8FF; line-height: 1.9; font-style: italic; letter-spacing: 0.8px;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #C9B8FF; line-height: 1.9; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.8px; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.a: color: #E6B800; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #E6B800; padding-bottom: 1px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; border: 1px solid #E6B800; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 38px; margin-bottom: 38px; height: 1px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#E6B800,transparent);
styles.code: background: rgba(230,184,0,0.12); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 90%; color: #E6B800; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif; font-style: italic;
styles.pre: background: #070011; border: 1px solid rgba(230,184,0,0.4); border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #E8E0FF; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: rgba(230,184,0,0.15); color: #E6B800; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-style: italic;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #E8E0FF; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(230,184,0,0.4);
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 500; color: #0B0118; background: #E6B800; font-style: italic; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.li: font-size: 15px; color: #E8E0FF; line-height: 2; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
